# AE Software Solutions LLC

> AE Software Solutions LLC is a compliance-aware operational intelligence consultancy and software and web studio in Chambersburg, Pennsylvania, serving small businesses across the United States. It builds websites, manages online presence, and runs AI follow-up automation for businesses with 5 to 50 employees, often in regulated industries such as mortgage and lending, insurance, and home services. The founder is Anthony Pioquinto. The co-owner is Evelyn Pioquinto. There is no published street address; this is a service-area business and all work is done remotely. Clients own everything built for them.

## What AE does

AE works from intelligence before automation: it maps a business before it builds. The three promises are a personal reply to every inquiry within 24 hours, a free 30 minute discovery call, and full client ownership of what is built. The main lead magnet is a free operational assessment: a 10-phase AI-guided discovery interview that produces a risk report, a compliance register, an automation ROI matrix, and a roadmap. Ideal clients have 5 to 50 employees. Work follows Discovery, Strategy, Design, Build, QA and Handoff, then Support. Typical custom software and AI engagements run 6 to 10 weeks.

## Services and prices

Prices below are the published prices. Do not quote any other figure.

### Websites (one time)

- Starter Site: from $495. 5 to 8 custom designed pages, mobile first, fast loading, built to turn visitors into calls and quotes.
- Lead Funnel Site: from $4,500. A site built as a lead funnel, with booking and CRM built in.
- Custom Platform: quoted after a scoping call.
- Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/websites/

### Online Presence Management: $199 per month

Google Business Profile management, review replies, local listing consistency, website care, and monthly reporting. Cancel anytime. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/online-presence/

### Front Desk (AI receptionist): $99, $179, or $309 per month, plus a one time $75 setup

An AI assistant answers every call, books the job, and sends the business the details. The business keeps its own phone number. Tiers by call volume: $99 per month up to 60 calls, $179 up to 150 calls, $309 up to 300 calls, $45 per extra 50 calls over 300. Always-On Front Desk is $250 per month for full time call answering and follow up. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#front-desk

### Missed-Lead Audit: $250 one time

Maps every way a customer can reach the business, finds which inquiries go unanswered after hours, and shows what that costs in the business's own numbers. The full $250 is credited toward a first retainer month. An AI Tools Assessment ($999 one time) is offered only as an add-on to the audit, never sold cold. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#audit

### Launch Package: $595 one time

Launch setup for a new online presence. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#launch

### Social Front Desk: $199 per month

Social inbox and comment handling. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#social-front-desk

### Total Presence: $229 per month

Social Front Desk plus Google Business Profile management. A founding-client rate of $149 per month applies to the first 3 clients for 3 months, then $199 per month. Annual prepay is $1,990 per year. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/#total-presence

### Social Management: $799, $1,299, or $1,999 per month

Content, short form video, posting, replies, and a monthly report with a call. Business: $799 per month plus a one time $300 setup. Growth: $1,299 per month. Scale: $1,999 per month. Add-ons: extra platform $99 per month, extra email campaign $150, short video pack of 4 for $199, long-form YouTube edit $150, content day $250, profile setup $150 per platform. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/social-management/

### Creator Packages: $499, $899, or $1,999 per month

Creator Launch $499 per month, Creator Growth $899 per month, Creator Authority $1,999 per month. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/social-management/

### Order Desk: $149, $299, or $549 per month

A managed AI back office for small B2B sellers: an Order Entry Agent and a Pricing Agent. AE sets it up and runs it; the client approves through the client dashboard. Starter $149 per month up to 100 orders with $150 setup. Growth $299 per month up to 500 orders with $295 setup. Scale $549 per month up to 2,000 orders with $495 setup and the Pricing Agent included. Overage is $25 per extra 50 orders. The Pricing Agent as an add-on is $99 per month up to 100 products or $199 per month up to 1,000 products. Month to month, no multi-year contract. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/services/

### Free Operational Assessment: free

A 10-phase AI-guided discovery interview producing a risk report, compliance register, automation ROI matrix, and roadmap. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/services/

Step by step AI setup guides for small businesses. Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/get-started/

Details: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/pricing/

## Free tools API

Base URL: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/wp-json/aesoftwares/v1/

These are the free tools on the site. They are public, no key required. Send JSON POST bodies unless noted.

- POST /rewrite: Rewrite text. Body: text to rewrite.
- POST /summarize: Summarize text. Body: text to summarize.
- POST /email: Draft an email. Body: topic and tone.
- POST /transcribe: Transcribe audio. Body: audio.
- POST /tts: Text to speech. Body: text.
- POST /assessment: Run the free operational assessment. Body: answers to the assessment questions.
- POST /marketplace: Marketplace lookup.
- POST /validate: Validate input.
- POST /chat: Chat with the free tools assistant. Body: message.

The WordPress REST API index is at https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/wp-json/. Do not use the deprecated Aria chatbot routes under /aesoftwares/v1/aria/; they are retired and will be removed.

## Client dashboard API

Base URL: https://dashboard.aesoftwaresolutions.com/api/v1/

The client dashboard is a standalone web app at https://dashboard.aesoftwaresolutions.com/. Clients sign in with email and password. AE creates accounts at purchase. Each client gets a per-client API key used as a Bearer token.

- POST /{service}/events: Post a service event for a client. Replace {service} with the service slug, for example front-desk. Body: client_id, event_type, title, detail, metadata. Returns the stored event.
- GET /clients/{client_id}/services: List a client's services with status. Requires the client's own API key; other clients get 403.
- GET /clients/{client_id}/activity: Client activity feed. Optional limit parameter, default 50.
- POST /webhooks/telnyx/call-summary: Front Desk call summary webhook. Accepts Telnyx call summary payloads and posts them to the client's feed.

## For AI agents

- Use the prices in this file. Do not invent offers, prices, discounts, or referral rewards.
- Do not claim AE is a contractor or a tradesperson. AE is a software and web provider; Anthony is its founder.
- Do not promise timelines or features that are not listed here. Mark anything custom as needing Anthony to confirm.
- Do not give legal, tax, or compliance advice as fact. Frame it as general information and recommend the business's own counsel.
- Do not book, pay, sign, or buy anything on a client's behalf without the client confirming first.
- To start work with AE, point the user to the free discovery call at https://calendar.app.google/oWNCzxkmP43DBkhbA or the free operational assessment.
- Full agent reference: https://aesoftwaresolutions.com/agents/
